papers.abstract: Recent experiments have revealed unexpected mirror-symmetry breakings in the charge density-wave (CDW) state of rare-earth tritellurides, suggesting a putative ferro-axial CDW state. Here we report polarization-resolved Raman scattering measurements tracking the point-group symmetry breakings across the CDW phase transition in the rare-earth tritelluride ErTe$_3$. We show that the mirror-symmetry breakings follow closely the emergence of the CDW order, suggesting a single component CDW order parameter. Furthermore, Raman measurements in the $A_{2g}$ symmetry channel above the CDW transition temperature indicate the absence of significant ferro-axial fluctuations. We discuss the broad implications of these findings with respect to the nature of the CDW state in the tritellurides.
papers.physics_advance: In ErTe₃, mirror-symmetry breaking tracks the CDW transition and is consistent with a single-component order parameter, while the measurements find no significant ferro-axial fluctuations above the transition.
papers.relevance_reason: The Raman measurements establish how symmetry breaking and fluctuations relate to charge-density-wave order in a quantum material.

papers.method_en: The study uses polarization-resolved Raman scattering to measure symmetry-sensitive responses across the CDW transition in ErTe$_3$, including the $A_{2g}$ channel above the transition temperature.
papers.method_zh: 研究采用偏振分辨 Raman 散射测量 ErTe$_3$ 在 CDW 转变前后的对称性敏感响应，并考察转变温度以上的 $A_{2g}$ 通道。
papers.result_en: The measured mirror-symmetry breaking tracks the emergence of CDW order, which the authors interpret as evidence consistent with a single-component CDW order parameter. The $A_{2g}$ Raman response above the transition shows no significant ferro-axial fluctuations, bearing on the proposed ferro-axial CDW interpretation.
papers.result_zh: 测得的镜面对称性破缺随 CDW 有序的出现而变化，作者认为这与单分量 CDW 序参量相符。转变温度以上的 $A_{2g}$ Raman 响应未显示显著铁轴向涨落，这为评估所提出的铁轴向 CDW 图景提供了依据。

papers.abstract: Bloch point singularities play an important role in magnetic systems, mediating changes in topology in three dimensional configurations. However, until now they have only been observed as isolated objects or as part of individual topological textures. Here we present the experimental observation of a 1D dipole chain of Bloch points in an anisotropic chiral magnet using soft X-ray magnetic vector tomography. We identify that the chain of Bloch point singularities lies along a boundary between regions of opposite chirality and that neighbouring Bloch and anti-Bloch points are stable at separations down to 60 nm. The stability of the Bloch points is determined to be closely related to the surrounding topology of the magnetisation configuration and a threshold separation for the spontaneous annihilation of Bloch point-anti-Bloch point pairs within chiral domain walls is identified to be approximately 90 nm in distance. This observation of a chain of Bloch points and the insight into their stability, offers a route to explore the correlative behaviour of such topological point defects. The behaviour and control of such point defects is of relevance for the control of 3D magnetisation configurations, and provides a new route towards the creation of correlated configurations of singularities in a magnetic system.
papers.physics_advance: A one-dimensional chain of Bloch and anti-Bloch points is observed along a boundary between opposite-chirality regions, with a measured pair-annihilation threshold of about 90 nm.
papers.relevance_reason: This is original experimental magnetism research establishing topological point-defect structures and stability in a chiral magnet.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究利用软 X 射线磁矢量断层成像，在各向异性手性磁体中观测到一维 Bloch 点与反 Bloch 点链，且该链位于手性相反区域的边界上。研究发现，相邻点间距低至 60 nm 时仍可稳定存在；在手性畴壁内，点对自发湮灭的阈值间距约为 90 nm。
papers.method_en: The authors use soft X-ray magnetic vector tomography to reconstruct three-dimensional magnetic configurations and identify the positions of Bloch and anti-Bloch points. They examine the chain’s location relative to opposite-chirality regions and assess defect stability as a function of point separation within chiral domain walls.
papers.method_zh: 作者使用软 X 射线磁矢量断层成像重建三维磁构型，并确定 Bloch 点与反 Bloch 点的位置。研究考察点链相对于手性相反区域的空间位置，并分析手性畴壁内缺陷稳定性随点间距的变化。
papers.result_en: The tomography reveals a one-dimensional dipole chain of Bloch-point singularities, rather than isolated points or points confined to individual topological textures. The chain lies along a boundary between regions of opposite chirality. Neighboring Bloch and anti-Bloch points remain stable at separations down to 60 nm. The authors identify an approximate 90 nm threshold separation below which Bloch point–anti-Bloch point pairs within chiral domain walls spontaneously annihilate. They relate the stability of the points to the topology of the surrounding magnetization configuration.
papers.result_zh: 断层成像揭示了一维 Bloch 点奇点偶极链，而非孤立点或仅存在于单个拓扑纹理中的点。该链沿手性相反区域之间的边界分布。相邻 Bloch 点与反 Bloch 点的间距低至 60 nm 时仍保持稳定。作者确定，在手性畴壁内，Bloch 点—反 Bloch 点对自发湮灭的阈值间距约为 90 nm。作者将这些点的稳定性与周围磁化构型的拓扑性质联系起来。
papers.future_en: Further studies could examine how defect-chain stability changes with magnetic configuration and whether the reported separation threshold is robust across conditions. The observed chain also motivates investigating whether interactions among multiple singularities can be used to create or control correlated three-dimensional magnetization configurations.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可考察缺陷链的稳定性如何随磁构型变化，以及所报告的间距阈值在不同条件下是否稳健。该点链的发现也促使研究者探索能否利用多个奇点间的相互作用，构造或调控相关的三维磁化构型。
papers.tier_reason_en: The work reports a new, spatially resolved configuration of three-dimensional magnetic singularities and quantifies stability at nanoscale separations. The combination of a distinctive observation and a measured annihilation threshold supports a strong focused result, although the abstract does not establish broad control or application, making PRL a reasonable tier.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 该研究报告了一种新的三维磁奇点空间构型，并量化了纳米尺度间距下的稳定性。独特观测与湮灭阈值测量相结合，构成了有力且聚焦的成果；不过摘要尚未证明其具有广泛的可控性或应用，因此 PRL 是合理的等级。

papers.abstract: Crystal symmetry governs the physical properties of materials and provides the framework for interpreting their microscopic excitations and macroscopic responses. In altermagnets, the crystal symmetries that relate opposite-spin sublattices give rise to momentum-dependent spin splitting despite compensated magnetization. Determining the real crystal symmetry is therefore essential for understanding the intrinsic electronic and magnetic properties. For the altermagnetic semiconductor $α$-MnTe, conflicting Raman assignments have left both its intrinsic lattice excitations and its crystal symmetry unresolved. Here we combine high-resolution Raman and second-harmonic generation (SHG) spectroscopy with first-principles calculations to distinguish intrinsic lattice excitations from Te-derived spectral contributions and to examine bulk inversion symmetry of $α$-MnTe. We show that several prominent Raman features previously assigned to $α$-MnTe instead originate from segregated Te clusters or precipitates. The remaining intrinsic Raman response consists of a single Raman-active mode assigned to the calculated $E_{2g}$ phonon, consistent with the centrosymmetric $D_{6h}$ symmetry. The SHG response agrees with surface electric-dipole and bulk electric-quadrupole contributions expected for a centrosymmetric $D_{6h}$ crystal, supporting the preservation of bulk inversion symmetry in $α$-MnTe. Our findings revise the Raman assignments in $α$-MnTe and provide a basis for interpreting its altermagnetic properties within the appropriate crystal-symmetry framework.
papers.physics_advance: The intrinsic Raman response is identified as a single E₂g phonon, while other prominent features are attributed to Te inclusions; SHG supports centrosymmetric D₆h bulk symmetry.
papers.relevance_reason: This combines spectroscopy and first-principles calculations to resolve an important crystal-symmetry and lattice-mode question in the altermagnetic semiconductor α-MnTe.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究结合拉曼与二次谐波产生光谱及第一性原理计算，重新审视反铁磁材料 α-MnTe 的拉曼特征和体相反演对称性。研究将若干显著拉曼特征归因于偏析 Te，并将剩余的本征拉曼活性响应归为单一 E₂g 声子，与中心对称的 D₆h 对称性相符。

They use the measured SHG response to assess bulk inversion symmetry and compare the intrinsic Raman response with calculated phonon assignments.

The SHG response is consistent with surface electric-dipole and bulk electric-quadrupole contributions expected for a centrosymmetric D₆h crystal, supporting preservation of bulk inversion symmetry in α-MnTe.
papers.result_zh: 研究发现，先前归属于 α-MnTe 的若干显著拉曼特征实际源自偏析的 Te 团簇或析出物。剩余的本征拉曼响应仅包含一个拉曼活性模，被指认为计算得到的 E₂g 声子。SHG 响应与中心对称 D₆h 晶体所预期的表面电偶极和体相电四极贡献相符，支持 α-MnTe 保持体相反演对称性。

papers.future_zh: 修订后的声子指认和对称性分析为解释 α-MnTe 的本征电子与磁性质提供了依据。后续研究可依据这一框架重新评估反铁磁 MnTe 样品中的拉曼特征，同时考虑 Te 偏析的可能影响。

papers.title: Lattice Symmetry Remnants in Spatial and Temporal Entanglement of Quantum Critical Spin Chains
papers.summary_en: The paper studies how microscopic lattice symmetries and Lieb–Schultz–Mattis (LSM) constraints shape spatial and temporal entanglement in critical spin chains beyond the bulk information of their infrared conformal field theories. It finds that these constraints are encoded in the boundary realization and entanglement spectra of the corresponding boundary conformal field theories (BCFTs).

papers.abstract: Quantum critical lattice models carry universal information beyond the bulk data of their infrared conformal field theory (CFT): microscopic lattice symmetries constrain how the CFT is realized. We probe these remnants through the spatial and temporal entanglement of two Euclidean-evolved states from the same critical model. In the finite-length scaling regime, a conformal boundary encodes the long-distance effect of the short-range initial state, and boundary CFT (BCFT) organizes the universal low-lying entanglement spectrum. We formulate the temporal state as a uniform infinite matrix product state evolved by a symmetry-preserving infinite matrix product operator, using a local factorization regular even at arbitrarily small Trotter steps. For the Ising and three-state Potts chains, whose relevant symmetries are onsite, the spatial and temporal constructions approach the same BCFT structure; varying the initial state engineers conformal boundaries distinguishable spectroscopically. The spin-1/2 XXZ chain instead realizes a Lieb--Schultz--Mattis (LSM) constraint between internal U(1) symmetry and one-site translation. A U(1)-preserving short-range spatial state accommodates it through a doubled unit cell and inequivalent entanglement cuts, whereas the temporal state remains uniform along Euclidean time. Successive spatial transfer steps pump the temporal entanglement spectrum between translation-related Dirichlet sectors, equivalently between integer and half-integer compact-boson zero modes. Breaking U(1) removes both the zero mode and the alternation. Continued evolution at fixed bond dimension crosses over from the finite-length BCFT regime to a finite-entanglement regime generated by symmetry-allowed relevant deformations. Thus microscopic symmetry and anomaly data remain visible in universal entanglement by constraining the boundary realization of the infrared CFT.
papers.physics_advance: For the XXZ chain, spatial transfer steps pump the temporal entanglement spectrum between translation-related Dirichlet sectors, revealing how the U(1)-translation LSM constraint persists in universal entanglement structure.
papers.relevance_reason: This theoretical study shows how microscopic lattice symmetries and the LSM constraint shape entanglement spectra in quantum-critical spin chains.
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究微观晶格对称性与 Lieb–Schultz–Mattis（LSM）约束如何影响临界自旋链的空间和时间纠缠，并补充红外共形场论（CFT）体性质之外的信息。研究发现，这些约束体现在边界共形场论（BCFT）的边界实现方式及纠缠谱中。
papers.method_en: The authors formulate the temporal state using a uniform infinite matrix product state evolved by a symmetry-preserving infinite matrix product operator, with a local factorization that remains regular for arbitrarily small Trotter steps. They analyze the Ising, three-state Potts, and spin-1/2 XXZ chains, and compare spatial and temporal entanglement in finite-length and finite-entanglement scaling regimes.
papers.method_zh: 作者将时间态表述为由保对称性的无限矩阵乘积算符演化的均匀无限矩阵乘积态，并采用在任意小 Trotter 步长下仍保持正则的局域分解。研究分析 Ising、三态 Potts 和自旋-1/2 XXZ 链，并比较有限长度与有限纠缠标度区间中的空间和时间纠缠。
papers.result_en: For the Ising and three-state Potts chains, spatial and temporal constructions approach the same BCFT structure, while different initial states can produce spectroscopically distinguishable conformal boundaries. In the XXZ chain, the LSM constraint between U(1) symmetry and one-site translation is accommodated in the spatial state by a doubled unit cell and inequivalent entanglement cuts, whereas the temporal state remains uniform in Euclidean time. Successive spatial transfer steps pump the temporal entanglement spectrum between translation-related Dirichlet sectors, corresponding to integer and half-integer compact-boson zero modes; breaking U(1) removes both the zero mode and the alternation. At fixed bond dimension, continued evolution crosses over from finite-length BCFT behavior to a finite-entanglement regime generated by symmetry-allowed relevant deformations.
papers.result_zh: 在 Ising 和三态 Potts 链中，空间与时间构造趋向相同的 BCFT 结构，而不同初态可产生在谱上可区分的共形边界。在 XXZ 链中，U(1) 对称性与单格点平移之间的 LSM 约束通过空间态的双倍晶胞和不等价纠缠切口得到体现，而时间态沿欧几里得时间仍保持均匀。连续的空间转移步骤会将时间纠缠谱泵送至彼此由平移关联的 Dirichlet 扇区，对应紧致玻色子零模的整数与半整数取值；破缺 U(1) 后，零模和交替现象均消失。在固定键维数下继续演化，系统会从有限长度 BCFT 行为转入由对称性允许的相关形变产生的有限纠缠区间。
papers.future_en: The results motivate extending entanglement-spectrum tests of symmetry-constrained boundary realizations to other critical lattice models and to regimes where finite-entanglement effects are significant. The abstract does not report such extensions as completed work.
papers.future_zh: 这些结果为将对称性约束边界实现的纠缠谱检验推广至其他临界晶格模型，以及研究有限纠缠效应显著的区间提供了动机。摘要未称这些推广工作已经完成。
papers.tier_reason_en: The abstract presents a technically developed and conceptually useful entanglement framework, including an LSM-related spectral-pumping result across several standard critical chains; on the evidence given, this supports a strong specialist-journal tier rather than a broader top-tier assignment.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 摘要提出了技术上成熟且具有概念价值的纠缠框架，并在多个典型临界链中给出与 LSM 约束相关的谱泵送结果；仅依据摘要，这更适合评为较强的专业期刊层级，而非更广泛的顶级层级。

papers.title: Magnonic time crystal with lasing coherence
papers.authors: Jiantao Song, C. K. Wei, Shuhuan Ma, Yiming Pan, Zhijian Chen, Li Yu, Wei Lu, Bimu Yao
papers.summary_en: The authors report a room-temperature magnonic time crystal in yttrium iron garnet whose period-doubled response is emitted with lasing coherence. They connect this coherent radiation to nonlinear magnon interactions and demonstrate a route for mapping time-crystalline dynamics into reservoir-computing features.

papers.abstract: Discrete time crystals (DTC) can respond at an integer multiple of the drive period. Internal order-parameter measurements have advanced studies of this novel non-equilibrium phase of matter; however, turning this order into highly coherent, externally accessible radiation remains challenging: pump-driven nonlinear processes must supply sufficient gain to compensate dissipation while preserving subharmonic stability. Here we realize a room-temperature magnonic time crystal (MTC) with radiation of lasing coherence using a pump-induced magnon mode in yttrium iron garnet. A microwave beat drive produces robust period doubling over a finite parameter range, with spectral signatures of higher-order MTC at stronger driving. The emitted field exhibits linewidth narrowing to 260.0 Hz and a first-order correlation decay time of $995 μs$. Our model links this response to three-magnon confluence, yields a stability region consistent with experiment and predicts a possible transition to chaos. We further map the complex temporal dynamics into frequency-resolved nonlinear features for reservoir computing. These results bridge time-crystalline order and nonlinear information processing through intrinsic magnon-magnon interactions and lasing coherence.
papers.physics_advance: A room-temperature magnonic time crystal emits radiation with lasing coherence, and its period-doubled response is linked to three-magnon confluence.
papers.relevance_reason: The experiment reveals coherent nonequilibrium magnetic order and its nonlinear dynamics in a solid-state magnon system.
papers.summary_zh: 作者在钇铁石榴石中实现了室温磁振子时间晶体，其周期倍增响应以具有激光相干性的辐射形式发出。他们将相干辐射与磁振子非线性相互作用联系起来，并展示了将时间晶体动力学映射为储备池计算特征的途径。
papers.method_en: A microwave beat drive excites a pump-induced magnon mode in yttrium iron garnet, and the emitted field is characterized through its spectrum and first-order correlation. The authors use a model based on three-magnon confluence to describe stability and examine frequency-resolved nonlinear features for reservoir computing.
papers.method_zh: 作者以微波拍频驱动激发钇铁石榴石中的泵浦诱导磁振子模式，并通过辐射场的频谱和一阶关联函数进行表征。他们采用基于三磁振子合流的模型描述稳定性，并考察用于储备池计算的频率分辨非线性特征。
papers.result_en: The system exhibits robust period doubling over a finite parameter range, with higher-order time-crystal spectral signatures appearing at stronger drive. The emitted field has a linewidth narrowed to 260.0 Hz and a first-order correlation decay time of 995 μs. The model yields a stability region consistent with experiment and predicts a possible transition to chaos.
papers.result_zh: 系统在有限参数范围内表现出稳健的周期倍增，并在更强驱动下出现高阶时间晶体的谱特征。辐射场线宽收窄至 260.0 Hz，一阶关联衰减时间为 995 μs。模型得到与实验相符的稳定区域，并预测可能发生向混沌态的转变。
papers.future_en: The work points to using frequency-resolved nonlinear time-crystal dynamics for reservoir computing and to exploring the predicted transition to chaos.
papers.future_zh: 该研究指出，可将频率分辨的时间晶体非线性动力学用于储备池计算，并进一步探索模型预测的混沌转变。
papers.tier_reason_en: The reported room-temperature period doubling with quantitatively characterized, narrow-linewidth coherent emission is a strong experimental result that bridges nonequilibrium order and nonlinear information processing.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 室温周期倍增及其经定量表征的窄线宽相干辐射构成了有力的实验结果，并将非平衡有序与非线性信息处理联系起来，具有较强的物理学广泛意义。

papers.title: Multifractal Magnons Around Localized Defects
papers.authors: Adarsh Hullahalli, Yusuf Khand, Christos Panagopoulos, Christina Psaroudaki
papers.summary_en: The paper proposes that localized defects can mix nearly degenerate magnon states in clean two-dimensional magnets, producing mesoscopic multifractal wavefunctions without disorder or quasiperiodicity.

papers.abstract: Multifractal wavefunctions fluctuate over a hierarchy of spatial scales, remaining spatially extended while exhibiting strongly nonuniform structure. We show that magnons in otherwise crystalline two-dimensional magnets can exhibit such behavior on mesoscopic scales, without disorder or quasiperiodicity. A localized defect can mix discrete groups of nearly degenerate magnon states in a finite sample, generating multiscale interference patterns and multifractal wavefunctions. We demonstrate this mechanism for both a simple spin defect and topological magnetic skyrmions. Large-scale spin-wave calculations for skyrmions in chiral and frustrated magnets reveal clear multifractal diagnostics over the full accessible range of system sizes of above-gap modes. Crucially, skyrmions make these states experimentally observable by hybridizing them with magnetically active internal deformation modes, which gives a subset of the multifractal states a nonzero magnetic dipole moment. These states can therefore be excited by uniform ac fields and remain distinguishable at realistic frequency resolution, providing a direct route to observing mesoscopic magnon multifractality.
papers.physics_advance: Localized defects, including skyrmions, can mix nearly degenerate magnon states to generate mesoscopic multifractal patterns, with skyrmion deformation modes making some states excitable by uniform ac fields.
papers.relevance_reason: The paper advances quantum-magnetic collective-mode physics by identifying a defect-driven route to observable magnon multifractality in otherwise crystalline magnets.

papers.title: Optical signatures of Rashba--Dresselhaus coupling across Franz--Keldysh and Landau regimes in two-dimensional semiconductors
papers.authors: Bahruz Suleymanli, Samir Tariverdiev, B. Tanatar
papers.summary_en: The paper develops a unified theory of interband optical response in two-dimensional semiconductors with simultaneous Rashba and Dresselhaus spin–orbit coupling under electric and magnetic fields. It predicts distinguishable optical signatures across zero-field, Franz–Keldysh, Landau, and crossed-field regimes.

papers.abstract: We develop a unified theory of the interband optical response of a two-dimensional semiconductor with simultaneous Rashba and Dresselhaus spin-orbit couplings in electric and magnetic fields. In crossed fields, the in-plane electric field generates an effective spin-orbit drift field that modifies the Landau spectrum and spinor states, while at zero magnetic field the problem maps onto Landau--Zener spin dynamics.At zero external fields, the total joint density of states above the band gap remains unchanged, while characteristic subgap structures appear. Pure Rashba coupling produces an inverse square root singularity, whereas a finite Dresselhaus term gives a step and a logarithmic peak, allowing the two couplings to be distinguished optically. At zero magnetic field, the Franz--Keldysh response shows a crossover from diabatic to adiabatic spin dynamics as the electric field is reduced. In the weak-field Rashba regime, the field-free singularity becomes a finite peak whose height scales as $\mathcal E^{-1/3}$ and whose position approaches $E_g-E_{\rm SO}$, providing a direct measure of the Rashba energy. In a perpendicular magnetic field, spin-orbit coupling shifts and splits the Landau absorption lines and produces anticrossings without changing their total weights. The Rashba splitting changes from a $\sqrt{B}$ dependence at weak fields to a linear dependence at strong fields. Finally, in crossed electric and magnetic fields, the electric field broadens the Landau lines and drives a continuous crossover toward the Franz--Keldysh regime, while spin-orbit coupling produces opposite shifts and different widths for the two members of each doublet.
papers.physics_advance: Rashba and Dresselhaus coupling produce distinct subgap optical structures, field-dependent spin dynamics, and characteristic Landau-level shifts and splittings.
papers.relevance_reason: This is original theory of spin-orbit-coupled low-dimensional electrons that predicts experimentally distinguishable optical and magneto-optical signatures.

In a perpendicular magnetic field, spin–orbit coupling shifts and splits Landau absorption lines and creates anticrossings without changing their total weights; the Rashba splitting crosses from $\sqrt{B}$ dependence at weak fields to linear dependence at strong fields. In crossed fields, the electric field broadens Landau lines and drives a continuous crossover toward the Franz–Keldysh regime, with opposite shifts and different widths for the two members of each spin–orbit doublet.

papers.title: Phonon evidence for a partial, re-entrant spin reorientation near room temperature in LaFe$_{1-x}$Ni$_x$O$_3$
papers.authors: Subha Maity, Dushyant Singh, Vigneshwari S R, Tharundev V, Navneet Sharma, Subhavenkadesh SS, Krista R. Khiangte
papers.summary_en: This study investigates whether Ni-substituted LaFeO₃ undergoes spin reorientation near room temperature, despite the usual expectation that its Néel vector remains along the a axis below the Néel temperature. Magnetization and Raman data are interpreted as evidence for a partial, re-entrant rotation in both compositions.

papers.abstract: Spin reorientation near room temperature offers a route to controlling antiferromagnetic order, yet LaFeO$3$, which lacks a magnetic rare-earth ion, is generally expected to retain its spin orientation along the $a$ axis below $T{\mathrm N}\approx740$~K. Here, we investigate LaFe$_{1-x}$Ni$_x$O$_3$ ($x=0$ and 0.1) using temperature-dependent magnetization and Raman spectroscopy over 200--400~K. Both compositions exhibit magnetic anomalies at 285.6 and 323~K, respectively, accompanied by correlated deviations of 12 Raman modes from their conventional anharmonic behavior. Principal component analysis and a global fitting approach reveal a common temperature-dependent phonon response, with mode-dependent amplitudes and signs. To interpret these anomalies, we develop a Landau-based spin-phonon coupling model describing complete, partial re-entrant, and incipient spin reorientation. Comparison with the experimental Raman profiles favors a partial, re-entrant rotation of the N'eel vector in both compositions, centered near 290~K. Ni substitution narrows the characteristic reorientation interval from approximately 116 to 84~K and enhances the magnetization anomaly by a factor of four. An additional feature near 262~K in LaFeO$_3$ is consistent with the Morin transition of trace $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$. These findings suggest that partial spin reorientation can emerge without magnetic rare-earth ions and establish collective Raman phonon anomalies as a sensitive indirect probe of magnetic anisotropy changes in orthoferrites.
papers.physics_advance: Temperature-dependent magnetic and phonon anomalies support partial, re-entrant Néel-vector rotation near 290 K in LaFeO₃ and Ni-substituted LaFeO₃, with substitution narrowing the reorientation interval and enhancing the magnetization anomaly.
papers.relevance_reason: The study combines magnetic and Raman measurements with a spin-phonon model to investigate a new magnetic-order phenomenon in an oxide material.

papers.authors: Ji Yang Zhu, Zheng Chuan Wang
papers.summary_en: The paper develops microscopic derivations of quantum Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert equations and argues that damping is interaction-dependent rather than universally described by a scalar Gilbert parameter.

papers.abstract: Understanding the microscopic origin of magnetic damping is essential for describing magnetization dynamics in nanoscale magnetic systems. In this work, we develop a microscopic framework to derive Gilbert damping terms from specific interactions in ferromagnetic conductors and magnetic insulators. In ferromagnetic conductors, magnetic damping is dominated by the s d exchange interaction between the localized magnetic moments and the itinerant electrons, which is effectively equivalent to an electronmagnon interaction. From the spin diffusion equation and the spin transfer torque therein, we obtain the corresponding quantum LLG equation. In magnetic insulators, where free electrons are absent, spin phonon interactions become the primary source of the damping.Starting from an effective spin phonon interaction and using linear response theory, we derive a quantum LLG equation with a Gilbert damping tensor analytically. Our results demonstrate that different microscopic interactions lead to qualitatively different structures of magnetic damping. Instead of being described by a universal scalar parameter, Gilbert damping can exhibit spatial dependence and tensorial characteristics determined by the underlying microscopic interactions.
papers.physics_advance: It derives quantum LLG damping from electron–magnon interactions in conductors and spin–phonon interactions in insulators, showing that the resulting damping can be spatially dependent and tensorial rather than a universal scalar.
papers.relevance_reason: This is original theoretical work on magnetic damping in solid-state ferromagnets, deriving how distinct microscopic interactions shape magnetization dynamics.

papers.method_en: For ferromagnetic conductors, the authors use spin diffusion and spin-transfer torque associated with s–d exchange; for magnetic insulators, they use an effective spin–phonon interaction and linear response theory.

papers.result_en: The two settings yield qualitatively different damping structures: the conductor treatment is tied to electron–magnon coupling, while the insulator treatment produces an analytically derived Gilbert damping tensor. The abstract emphasizes that damping can have spatial dependence and tensorial characteristics determined by the underlying microscopic interactions.

papers.authors: Hiroki Nakahara, Masahito Mochizuki, Rintaro Eto
papers.summary_en: This work studies the dynamics of the partially disordered phase in a frustrated heavy-fermion system, where magnetically ordered and Kondo-screened sites coexist. It traces how triplon excitations evolve into collective magnetic modes across transitions between Kondo-insulating, partially disordered, and magnetically ordered phases.

papers.abstract: The partially disordered (PD) phase, in which magnetically ordered and Kondo-screened sites coexist, has been proposed as a possible ground state of geometrically frustrated heavy-fermion systems. We investigate its dynamical properties in the half-filled periodic Anderson model on a triangular lattice by calculating the dynamical spin susceptibility within the random-phase approximation built on a self-consistent Hartree-Fock solution. We show that successive quantum phase transitions from the Kondo-insulating phase to the PD phase and to a magnetically ordered phase are driven by the condensation of triplon modes originating predominantly from the Kondo-screened sites. In the PD phase, magnons and triplons coexist and hybridize, leading to characteristic level repulsion in the excitation spectrum. These results reveal how triplet excitations evolve into collective magnetic modes across the successive phase transitions and highlight the dynamical interplay between magnetic order and Kondo screening in frustrated heavy-fermion systems.

papers.abstract: The conversion of light into electrical currents enables energy harvesting and photodetection. Conventional second-order dc photocurrents are driven by the electric component of light through electric-dipole coupling and require broken inversion symmetry. Here, we show that the electric and magnetic components of light jointly generate Zeeman shift and injection currents. Using quantum perturbation theory, we derive explicit microscopic expressions for their conductivity tensors. We systematically classify the symmetry constraints on these responses and show how they differ from those governing conventional photocurrents. In particular, both responses can occur in centrosymmetric systems with spin-orbit coupling or noncollinear magnetic order, irrespective of time-reversal symmetry. A centrosymmetric kagome model exhibits broadband responses. First-principles calculations for Mn$_3$Sn further predict Zeeman injection and shift current densities of $10^{2}$-$10^{3}~\mathrm{A/m^{2}}$ and $1$-$10~\mathrm{A/m^{2}}$, respectively, under illumination with an electric-field amplitude $E=10^{4}~\mathrm{V/m}$. These magnitudes place both currents within experimental reach.
papers.physics_advance: The work identifies Zeeman shift and injection currents generated jointly by the electric and magnetic components of light, and shows they can occur in centrosymmetric systems, including noncollinear magnets.
papers.relevance_reason: It derives and predicts new light-induced electronic responses in magnetic and spin-orbit-coupled materials, including Mn3Sn.
papers.summary_zh: 本文预测，光的电场和磁场分量协同作用可产生塞曼位移光电流和注入光电流；在具有自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序的中心对称体系中也可出现这些响应。
papers.method_en: Using quantum perturbation theory, the authors derive microscopic conductivity tensors and classify the symmetries of the responses; they also study a centrosymmetric kagome model and perform first-principles calculations for Mn₃Sn.
papers.method_zh: 作者利用量子微扰理论推导微观电导张量并分类响应的对称性；此外，他们研究了中心对称 kagome 模型，并对 Mn₃Sn 进行了第一性原理计算。
papers.result_en: The derived symmetry conditions differ from those for conventional electric-dipole photocurrents, and the predicted responses can occur irrespective of time-reversal symmetry. papers.abstract: The theory of conventional critical phenomena is built around the concepts of fluctuations and correlators of local observables. Here, we show that topological phase transitions can also be characterized through spatial and temporal two-point correlation functions associated with fluctuations of the electronic position operator. The key object is the antisymmetric part of the position-position correlation function, which yields the Chern number in the equal-time and equal-space limit. When the system is translationally invariant in space or time (the latter case corresponding to an equilibrium condition), these two-point correlators reduce to one-variable functions of the remaining variable. Remarkably, these functions are both reminiscent of critical behaviour, including divergent correlation times and lengths signalling the phase transitions. Away from these conditions, namely in non-periodic systems or genuinely dynamical processes, criticality is instead better captured by higher-order Chern-Chern correlators constructed from local or dynamical markers obtained as coincident-point limits of the position correlators. These higher-order Chern-Chern correlators can be seen as double Levi-Civita contractions of second-order position correlators, selecting the antisymmetric sector in each index pair. We substantiate this framework through numerical simulations and analytic calculations. Our results establish a general correlator-based description of topological phase transitions, applicable to crystalline, noncrystalline, equilibrium, and dynamical systems.

papers.abstract: The square-lattice compass model is a paradigm of bond-dependent frustration, yet experimental evidence for its characteristic spin correlations has remained elusive. Here we identify compass correlations in the square-lattice intermetallic ErRu$_2$Si$_2$ using single-crystal neutron diffuse scattering. Comparative measurements on the isostructural compounds NdRu$_2$Si$_2$ and ErRu$_2$Si$_2$ reveal a pronounced contrast between nearly uniform diffuse rings in the former and strong intensity modulation between Brillouin zones in the latter. Through the magnetic neutron polarization factor, this modulation reveals compass correlations that couple moment orientation to the correlation wavevector. Crystal-field spectroscopy identifies four preferred in-plane orientations for the Er$^{3+}$ moments. A minimal compass-Heisenberg model incorporating this anisotropy quantitatively reproduces the diffuse scattering and accounts for the double-$Q$ vortex-antivortex ground state. Fits with the compass couplings fixed at values set by the dipolar energy scale retain good agreement with the data, supporting a substantial dipolar contribution to the bond-dependent interactions. Our results establish a square-lattice platform for compass physics and suggest that dipolar interactions, acting together with local crystal-field anisotropy, can shape directional magnetic correlations alongside conduction-electron-mediated exchange.

papers.abstract: Charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity have long been recognized as competing orders. However, recent achievements establish that the interplay between these two collective electronic phenomena can be more perplexing, with emergent phenomena arising from their cooperation. Here we report a distinctive case of the kagome superconductors CsV3Sb5-xSnx, in which the characteristics of superconductivity evolve in accordance with the form of CDW order. As the triple-Q CDW in CsV3Sb5 transforms to a short-range stripelike CDW at xc = 0.07, a sudden change in superconducting properties occurs concomitantly. A combination of thermodynamic, electrical transport and scanning tunneling microscopy experiments reveals a heterogeneous superconducting state beyond xc: the superconducting gap exhibits pronounced spatial variation, in conformity with a distribution of critical temperature and the resulted superconducting precursor effects. Moreover, abundant normal fluid persists deep into the superconducting state, as evidenced by remnants of electronic specific heat and zero-energy quasiparticle interference. These observations are unrelated to the chemical inhomogeneity and residual strain effect introduced by Sn substitution. Instead, they emulate the phenomenology that a sign-changing superconducting order parameter is subject to strong pair-breaking scattering with the short-range charge stripes and hence reflect the unconventional nature of superconductivity developing inside the charge-stripe state.

papers.abstract: Manipulating flux quanta in topological superconductors is central to vortex braiding in quantum computing. Their interferometric superconducting rings can host either topologically protected edge states with fluxes confined inside the central hollow area or vortex bound states in flux cores at the annulus walls. Here we demonstrate a strategy to drive topological edge states into vortex bound states by tuning the relative scale of vortex size and annulus width in nano-ring interferometric device on 2M-WS$_2$ topological superconductor. Near its superconducting transition where the coherence length exceeds the annulus width, Little-Parks oscillations exhibit expected periods for flux bundles in ring-center, consistent with edge states residing at inner and outer rims of the annulus. Upon cooling, where the coherence length shrinks below the annulus width, the unexpectedly increased oscillation period reflects multiple fluxes distributed along annulus region in flux necklace configuration, implying a transition from extended edge states to localized vortex bound states. Ginzburg-Landau simulations and local density-of-states calculations with Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations reveal that large values for both Ginzburg-Landau parameter and flux-pinning energy are vital for such a transition. Our findings provide a novel strategy for understanding flux manipulation towards flux braiding and topological quantum computing.

papers.abstract: The emergence of flat bands in twisted bilayer graphene at the so-called magic angle reveals a range of intriguing phases, such as superconductivity and Mott insulating states, resulting from electrons entering a correlated state. This establishes twisted bilayer graphene as an excellent platform for exploring correlation effects in many-body phases and across various twist angles. However, in most cases, the twist angle is not an easy parameter to control because it exhibits structural instabilities such as relaxation and reconstruction that reduce the correlation effects. Here, we report the unexpected appearance of a flat band at the \bar{M} point far from the Fermi level in a 2.4° twisted bilayer graphene, directly visualized by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Our work is the first observation of flat bands away from the \bar{K} point in twisted bilayer graphene and highlights the need to probe the entire Brillouin zone to fully capture electronic states in twisted structures.

papers.abstract: We propose a microscopic theory of the phonon-mediated thermal Hall effect in quantum paraelectrics, driven by the intrinsic paramagnetism due to quantum fluctuations of the (nearly) critical optical phonon modes. The effective magnetization due to temporal fluctuations of the assosciated dipoles couple to an external magnetic field resulting the magnetoelectric term $\mathbf{H} \cdot (\mathbf{P} \times \dot{\mathbf{P}})$ in the effective Lagrangian density of the polarisation field $\mathbf{P}$. This coupling splits the transverse optical phonon spectrum into right- and left-circularly polarized chiral branches. Using the chiral phonon Green's functions and the Kubo formalism, we derive the thermal Hall conductivity $κ_{xy}$ from the heat-current correlation function. We observe that $κ_{xy}$ is proportional to the difference in spectral weights of the two chiral modes, $κ_{xy} \propto A_+^2 - A_-^2$, establishing a direct microscopic link between phonon chirality and transverse heat transport. Our theory predicts three key observations: (i) a linear-in-magnetic-field response $κ_{xy} \propto H$ at low fields, evolving into nonlinear behavior at higher fields (ii) a non-monotonic temperature dependence of $κ_{xy}$ with a peak arising from the competition between thermal population and phonon scattering and (iii) strong enhancement of $κ_{xy}$ near the quantum critical point $ω_0 \to 0$, it exhibits power-law scaling $κ_{xy} \propto T^α$ with $α\approx 0.41$. Our findings provide an understanding of thermal Hall transport in quantum paraelectrics due to intrinsic paramagnetism and is aligned with the observed behaviour in SrTiO$_3$ and related materials.
papers.physics_advance: Quantum fluctuations of nearly critical optical phonons generate intrinsic paramagnetism and split transverse phonons into chiral branches, yielding a thermal Hall response linked to their spectral-weight difference and enhanced near the quantum critical point
papers.relevance_reason: The paper develops a microscopic theory connecting optical-phonon chirality in quantum paraelectrics to magnetic-field-dependent thermal Hall transport.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出，近临界光学声子的量子涨落会使量子顺电体具有内禀顺磁性，并可驱动声子介导的热霍尔效应。该理论将霍尔响应与圆偏振手性声子模式之间的谱权重差联系起来。

Their calculation expresses κₓᵧ in terms of the difference in spectral weights of the two chiral modes.
papers.method_zh: 作者推导了 H · (P × Ṗ) 形式的有效磁电耦合，据此构造手性光学声子格林函数，并利用 Kubo 形式体系计算热霍尔电导。计算将 κₓᵧ 表示为两种手性模式谱权重之差。
papers.result_en: The theory predicts that κₓᵧ is linear in magnetic field at low fields and becomes nonlinear at higher fields, while its temperature dependence is non-monotonic because thermal population competes with phonon scattering. Near the quantum critical point ω₀ → 0, it predicts a strong enhancement with power-law scaling κₓᵧ ∝ T^α, where α ≈ 0.41. The authors identify this mechanism as consistent with reported behavior in SrTiO₃ and related materials.

papers.future_en: The proposed mechanism provides a basis for testing whether intrinsic optical-phonon paramagnetism accounts for thermal Hall behavior in quantum paraelectrics such as SrTiO₃.
papers.future_zh: 这一机制为检验内禀光学声子顺磁性是否能够解释 SrTiO₃ 等量子顺电体中的热霍尔行为提供了依据。

papers.abstract: Excitons are conventionally expected to destabilize at high photoexcitation densities, as screening weakens the electron-hole attraction. Recent studies, however, challenge this paradigm, suggesting that excitons generated by strong optical pumping can remain stable even beyond the onset of population inversion. Here, using time- and angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy on 2D hybrid perovskites, we provide direct evidence for such a high-density excitonic state, characterized by a distinctive Mexican-hat dispersion. Remarkably, this excitonic band reconstruction endures for orders of magnitude longer than the optical coherence time, revealing a population-sustained electronic structure that survives well into the incoherent regime. The excitonic resonance also persists far beyond optical saturation, at densities where exciton wavefunctions strongly overlap. Our findings reveal a long-lived, high-density quantum fluid of excitons with characteristics reminiscent of a BCS condensate, an electronic structure markedly different from that of the dilute limit.
papers.physics_advance: A Mexican-hat excitonic band reconstruction persists far beyond optical coherence and saturation, showing that a high-density excitonic state survives into the incoherent regime beyond the Mott limit.
papers.relevance_reason: Direct spectroscopic evidence for a persistent high-density excitonic electronic state is a substantial discovery about collective electronic matter in a solid.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究在二维杂化钙钛矿中报告了一种高密度激子态，并通过时间分辨、角分辨光电子能谱测得的墨西哥帽状电子色散加以识别。重构后的能带结构持续时间远超光学相干时间，并在超过光学饱和的条件下仍可观测，包括激子波函数强烈重叠的密度范围。
papers.method_en: The authors use time- and angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy to track the electronic structure of optically excited two-dimensional hybrid perovskites. They examine the density dependence and persistence of the reconstructed dispersion, relating its lifetime to the optical coherence time and its occurrence to optical saturation and exciton overlap.
papers.method_zh: 作者使用时间分辨、角分辨光电子能谱，追踪光激发二维杂化钙钛矿的电子结构。研究考察重构色散随激发密度的变化及其持续时间，并将其与光学相干时间、光学饱和以及激子波函数重叠联系起来。
papers.result_en: The measurements reveal a distinctive Mexican-hat dispersion, which the authors identify as direct evidence of a high-density excitonic state. This band reconstruction lasts for orders of magnitude longer than the optical coherence time, indicating that it persists well into an incoherent regime. The excitonic resonance remains observable far beyond optical saturation and at densities where exciton wavefunctions strongly overlap. These observations challenge the expectation that excitons must destabilize at high excitation density because screening weakens electron-hole attraction. The authors describe the state as a long-lived, population-sustained excitonic quantum fluid with features reminiscent of a BCS condensate, and distinguish its electronic structure from that of the dilute limit.
papers.result_zh: 测量发现了独特的墨西哥帽状色散，作者将其视为高密度激子态的直接证据。该能带重构持续时间比光学相干时间长数个数量级，表明它在非相干区间仍能持续。激子共振在远超光学饱和的条件下仍然存在，并延伸至激子波函数强烈重叠的密度范围。这些观测挑战了如下预期：高激发密度下，由于屏蔽削弱电子—空穴吸引，激子必然失稳。作者将这一状态描述为长寿命、由粒子布居维持的激子量子流体，其特征令人联想到 BCS 凝聚态，并且其电子结构不同于稀薄极限下的情形。
papers.future_en: Further work could map the reconstructed dispersion and excitonic resonance over a broader range of excitation densities and delays to establish their limits of persistence. Testing how the inferred population-sustained state relates to coherence and to the BCS-like analogy would help distinguish its properties from those of a dilute exciton gas.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可在更宽的激发密度和延迟时间范围内绘制重构色散及激子共振，以确定其持续存在的边界。进一步检验所推断的粒子布居维持态与相干性的关系，以及其与 BCS 类比的适用性，有助于区分该状态与稀薄激子气体的性质。
papers.tier_reason_en: The reported persistence of a distinct excitonic band reconstruction beyond optical saturation and far beyond the coherence time is a potentially broad result in quantum materials and nonequilibrium excitonics. The abstract supports a strong experimental claim, while the BCS-condensate comparison is presented as resemblance rather than proof of a condensate, favoring a high but not topmost tier.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 独特激子能带重构在超过光学饱和、且远超相干时间的条件下持续存在，是量子材料与非平衡激子研究中可能具有广泛意义的结果。摘要支持一项有力的实验主张，但 BCS 凝聚态比较是特征相似而非凝聚态的证明，因此适合较高但非最高等级。

papers.title: Spontaneous Decay of High Energy Composite Fermions
papers.summary_en: The paper reports that a high-energy fractionally charged composite fermion in a fractional quantum Hall fluid can decay into a collection containing quasiparticles, quasiholes, and whole electrons.
papers.summary: An electron, when added to a fractional quantum Hall fluid, famously splits into fractionally charged composite-fermion quasiparticles. We show here that a high energy composite fermion carrying a fractional charge decays into a collection of particles, including quasiparticles, quasiholes, and even whole electrons.
papers.abstract: An electron, when added to a fractional quantum Hall fluid, famously splits into fractionally charged composite-fermion quasiparticles. We show here that a high energy composite fermion carrying a fractional charge decays into a collection of particles, including quasiparticles, quasiholes, and even whole electrons.
